commands.name: SetServiceRequestCustomer
steps: outside writer lock preview current SR Customer, target Customer lifecycle and LLD-06 classification impact
inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork re-read SR revision/current Customer and revalidate non-null target through LLD-02
on exact no-change return semantic NO_CHANGE without new relationship history
supersede prior active sr_customer_relationship when present
insert new active row when customer_org_id is non-null, preserving reviewed origin/proposal evidence
invoke LLD-06 ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant.apply_customer_change in the same UnitOfWork using the new Customer or unresolved/null context
audit prior/new Customer and immutable result references
rules: Customer label/name/account code never becomes relationship identity
LLD-06 participant failure or INDETERMINATE aborts the entire change
changing Customer never silently changes Contact affiliation or selects a replacement CPL

commands.name: SetServiceRequestContactReference
steps: preview current role relationship, current SR Customer context, Contact lifecycle/current affiliation and exact source observation when role=current_handler_reference
inside UnitOfWork revalidate SR revision/current role relationship/Contact and current Customer context

for current_handler_reference require supporting source observation equals sr_current_source_projection.current_handler_observation_id and is field current_handler_label; otherwise SR_HANDLER_REFERENCE_STALE
for customer_contact when source-backed, require supporting observation is field customer_contact_label; manual review may omit source support
if current Contact affiliation disagrees with current SR Customer require explicit fresh mismatch review; do not mutate Contact affiliation
supersede prior active role relationship when present
when contact_id non-null insert new active role row with immutable customer_org_context_id and source/reconciliation provenance
audit prior/new reference and affiliation context
rules: Current Handler Contact reference is only an identity resolution of source-owned handler text and cannot create a local handler string
clearing a relationship never deletes/archives/modifies Contact
source changes may make an old handler reference non-current without deleting its history

import_contact_reconciliation_base_token.input: one existing Service Request, reference_role customer_contact|current_handler_reference, exact reviewed target Contact UUIDv4 and exact supporting source_observation_field_id

object.target_contact: null if target Contact is absent, otherwise exact {revision,lifecycle_state}
object.target_current_affiliation: null if target Contact has no current affiliation, otherwise exact {contact_affiliation_id,customer_org_id}
object.source_observation_field_id: canonical UUIDv4 of exact reviewed supporting source field authority

import_contact_reconciliation_base_token.digest: lowercase SHA-256 over LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json UTF-8 bytes
rules: invalid reference_role fails closed rather than hashing guessed state
proposal construction and writer revalidation must call the same owner reader and must not reconstruct these bytes
any drift in SR source/reference authority, matching profile, target Contact revision/lifecycle, target current affiliation or exact supporting source field changes the token

import_service_rule: When called from LLD-04 accepted reconciliation, the equivalent ServiceRequestReferenceService methods participate in LLD-04's already-open UnitOfWork and command receipt instead of nesting these standalone wrappers.
